metadata.program: SkyraSoft HBOS Public Distribution & Multi-Tenant Platform Integrity Program

changes.purpose: Attach Tenantable and Branchable traits to SupplierReturn model.
changes.security_impact: Prevents cross-tenant IDOR access to supplier returns.

changes.purpose: Central configuration for client/server version handshake and update gating.
changes.security_impact: Gating prevents outdated client payloads from corrupting database.

changes.purpose: Inspects client semver and sync schema headers; returns HTTP 426 when client is outdated.
changes.frontend_impact: Enables automated in-app update notification banner.

changes.purpose: Email normalization, atomic defaults seeding (Main Cash + Settings), forgotPassword, resetPassword, logoutAllDevices.
changes.backend_impact: Complete self-service lifecycle with rate limiting and session revocation.
changes.frontend_impact: Enables full recovery and remote session termination.
changes.security_impact: Eliminates credential stuffing and token hijack risks.

changes.purpose: Attach CheckClientVersion middleware, throttle middleware to auth routes, and register password recovery routes.
changes.backend_impact: Enforces API-wide versioning and brute-force throttling.
changes.security_impact: Prevents bot account creation and brute-force login.

changes.purpose: Store brand image uploads in businesses/{business_id}/brands directory.
Store product image uploads in businesses/{business_id}/products directory.
Dynamic tenant-namespaced database naming HBOS_Store_Biz_${business_id} and lifecycle open/close hooks.
changes.frontend_impact: Isolates IndexedDB stores per active business on shared PC.
changes.local_data_impact: Preserves offline outbox records upon logout without data loss.
changes.security_impact: Completely eliminates cross-tenant catalog/customer debt visibility.

changes.purpose: Wire openTenantDatabase and closeTenantDatabase on login/logout; add logoutAllDevices action.
changes.frontend_impact: Safe session cleanup and remote multi-device revocation.
changes.local_data_impact: Detaches active database instance on logout.
changes.security_impact: Ensures state is wiped from memory while keeping IndexedDB durable.

changes.purpose: Send X-HBOS-App-Version and X-HBOS-Sync-Schema-Version headers; dispatch update events on status headers/HTTP 426.
changes.frontend_impact: Seamless version negotiation with cloud backend.

changes.purpose: Automated test suite verifying registration atomicity, defaults seeding, auth throttling, password recovery, session invalidation, IDOR protection, and version negotiation.
